graph.name: 7. Let a second model polish the narration
graph.description:
Apply pre-generation direction, then revise only narration while preserving protected literals.

Open this independent unified workflow document and enable Lattice before Send. Ordinary generation uses Active SillyTavern.
Bind Prose to Active SillyTavern or a chosen local model.

Open Let a second model polish the narration and inspect the named pins.
Compare the native Draft with the narration-only revision before Apply.
Send in a disposable story, inspect checkpoints, then explicitly Apply or Reject. Preview never publishes or settles proposals.

Calls: 1 auxiliary Revise Draft request after one ordinary native generation.
Checkpoints:
Revise Draft · narration pass.out: Narration changes; dialogue and the protected literal remain unchanged.

direction.title: Text
direction.text: Describe the scene through concrete sounds and movement; preserve dialogue and player agency.

polish.title: Revise Draft
polish.instructions: Tighten repetition and sentence rhythm. Preserve facts, chronology, all dialogue and North Harbor exactly.
